sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining — accessing a property on nil silently returns nil, propagating absence without error
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone who isn't there doesn't crash your world; it just quietly yields nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The type 'Void' is an uninhabited type — no value can ever be constructed of it, yet it can be declared
sketches.resonance: A promise whose type makes it impossible to fulfill is a promise that can never be kept.

sketches.mechanism: method_missing — when you call a method that doesn't exist, Ruby lets the object hear the name of what was asked for before failing
sketches.resonance: Even what is absent leaves a name behind; the object hears every word it cannot answer.
